raw_response:
I was lucky to receive FISP coupons this year, so I will apply both NPK and urea on this main maize plot to get a good harvest for my family. I will also put manure from my goats because the soil needs strength, and I will plant the hybrid seed they gave us at the extension office since it yields better than local maize. We do not use pesticides or irrigation here in Dedza, so I am waiting for the November rains and will weed by hand. My children and I will work most days on this plot, but I will hire a neighbor for five days when the land preparation and weeding become too hard for me.
